summary: F2 refactor (useEmissionFormState hook integration in EmissionEntryForm.js) frontend verification. Verified: (1) /emissions page loads with ZERO console errors and ZERO page errors; (2) Add Emission dialog opens cleanly — facility selector, scope radios (Scope 1/2/3/Biogenic), category dropdown, fuel dropdown all render and are interactive; Scope 1 -> Stationary Combustion -> Diesel chain works with native HTML <select>s and correct option lists (41 fuels load, Diesel id=ghg-modularize); (3) Step 2 fields (process name input placeholder='Process Name 1', responsible person, designation, contact) accept input and persist; (4) Dirty-tracking useEffect (intentionally KEPT inline per plan, NOT moved into hook) fires correctly — confirmed by 'Unsaved Changes — discard?' modal appearing when navigating away after editing form fields; (5) Edit buttons resolve via [data-testid*=edit-emission] (8 found on page); (6) Hook source file /app/frontend/src/modules/ghg/emissions/shared/hooks/useEmissionFormState.js correctly owns 60+ useState + 4 useEffects (org-year-type sync, decisionFieldValues sync for scope3Method/ActivityType/Subcategory, custom-activity auto-enable on 'others'+supplier_basis, editingEmission yearlyData hydration). State setters are properly destructured and returned from the hook; no NameError, no undefined ref leaks at runtime.

design_issues.screen: Add Emission Dialog (pre-existing, NOT introduced by F2)
issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' and '<span> cannot be a child of <select>' — likely from a Radix/Slot wrapping a native HTML <select>/<option>. Cosmetic, does not break form. Pre-existing — same warning would appear in pre-F2 build because the JSX for the selects was NOT touched by F2.

Step 2 form inputs (process name, responsible person, designation, contact) have NO data-testid attributes — tests must fall back to placeholder selectors which is brittle. Same applies to Step 3 number inputs and the Save button.

critical_code_review_comments: [POSITIVE — hook structure is clean] useEmissionFormState.js (289 lines) correctly groups 60+ useState into logical sections (Step 1, Scope 3, Biogenic, Multi-Employee C7, Decision Tree, Process Emissions, Dynamic Form Config, Step 2, Step 3, Step 4, Scope 3 optional). The destructured return object covers every state slot used by the form.

[POSITIVE — all 4 useEffects moved correctly] (a) hasOrgYearTypePreference -> setReportingYearType(defaultYearType); (b) [scope3Method, scope3ActivityType, scope3Subcategory] -> setDecisionFieldValues sync; (c) [scope3ActivityType, scope3Method] -> auto-enable useCustomActivity on 'others'+supplier_basis; (d) [editingEmission] -> frequencyType + yearlyData hydration with cv/density override flags + user_overrides — all four match the refactor plan exactly.

[POSITIVE — dirty-tracking correctly KEPT inline] The Unsaved-Changes prompt firing in test proves the dirty-tracking useEffect remained in EmissionEntryForm.js as intended (lines 826-832 per plan) and was NOT erroneously moved into the hook (where it would lose access to onFormChange prop closure).

[POSITIVE — defaultYearType derivation is pure] orgReportingYearType + hasOrgYearTypePreference + defaultYearType computed each render with no useMemo (fine, cheap string compares). Initial useState(defaultYearType) plus the sync effect together cover both first-mount and prop-change cases.

[NIT — minor risk in editingEmission effect] The hydration effect at line 166 runs on EVERY editingEmission identity change but does NOT reset yearlyData when freq becomes 'monthly' — could leave stale yearlyData if you switch from a yearly record to a monthly one in the same dialog. Pre-existing behavior likely (same code path existed before F2), but worth a follow-up audit.

[NIT — testability gap] Step 2/3/4 form inputs (process name, responsible person, monthly qty cells, save button) lack data-testid attributes. Adding e.g. data-testid='process-name-input-0', 'responsible-person-input', 'monthly-qty-<month>-input', 'save-emission-button' would unblock deterministic E2E tests of the full Save flow.

[INFO — pre-existing hydration warnings] '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' / '<span> cannot be a child of <select>' is a Radix-Slot-on-native-select issue, NOT a refactor regression. JSX was not changed by F2.
